title: The new pattern for dual NOTCH pathway involving nuclear transcription and mitochondrial regulation supports therapeutic mechanism of 4-butyl benzophenone derivatives against SIRS.
authors: Song, Jiayu; Peng, Dan; Peng, Yu; Zhao, Guang; Ren, Yuan; Guo, Lina; Ren, Luyao; Zhang, Xiaohui; Xie, Xiaoxia; Zhang, Yajie; Cao, Lingya; Li, Yunlan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯甲酮衍生物通过NOTCH1双通路抗炎机制，虽涉及NOTCH1蛋白与配体结合及核转录调控，但核心是药物靶点与炎症通路，非TF-DNA结合位点预测或互作机制建模，仅含分子对接且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS) represents a self-amplifying cascade of inflammatory reactions and pathophysiological states triggered by infectious or non-infectious factors. The identification of disease targets and differential proteins in the liver (the unique and important immune organ) of SIRS mice treated with the lead compound D1 was conducted using the Genecards database and proteomic analysis, respectively. Subsequently, NOTCH1 was identified as the potential hub target via an intersection analysis between the aforementioned differentially expressed proteins and disease targets. Based on our previous research on the structure-activity relationship, we designed and synthesized a series of SIRS-related derivatives, wherein butyl, halogen, and ester groups were incorporated into benzophenone, aiming at exploring the anti-inflammatory protective action from the perspective of macrophage polarization. Notably, these derivatives exhibited a direct binding capability to the O-glucosylation site (SER496) or its vicinities (such as SER492, VAL485) of NOTCH1 using docking, SPR, DARTS, and CETSA techniques. Mechanistically, derivative D6 exerted anti-inflammatory effects via the dual NOTCH pathway. Firstly, it could inhibit NOTCH1 nuclear transcriptional activity, attenuate the interaction between NICD and RBPJK, concurrently suppress NF-kappaB and NLRP3 inflammasome (NLRP3, ASC, and cleaved CASP1) activation, and promote NICD (NOTCH1 active fragments) ubiquitination metabolism (the nuclear transcriptional pathway). Secondly, it might possess the ability to increase PGC1alpha level, subsequently, enhance ATP and MMP levels, mitigate ROS production, increase mitochondrial numbers, and ameliorate mitochondrial inflammatory damage (the mitochondrial pathway). Importantly, the activator Jagged1 could effectively reverse the aforementioned effects, while the inhibitor DAPT exhibited a synergistic effect, suggesting that the nuclear transcriptional regulation and mitochondrial regulation were both in a NOTCH1-dependent manner. Subsequently, it effectively alleviated the inflammatory response and preserved organ function as evidenced by up-regulating M2-type macrophage-related anti-inflammatory cytokines (IL10, TGFbeta, CD206, and ARG1) and down-regulating M1-type macrophage-related pro-inflammatory cytokines (NO, IL6, IL18, iNOS, TNFalpha, CD86, and IL1beta). In a word, derivative D6 modulated macrophage polarization and effectively mitigated SIRS by targeting inhibition of the dual NOTCH pathway.
abstract_zh: 全身性炎症反应综合征（SIRS）是由感染性或非感染性因素触发的一种自我放大的炎症反应级联及病理生理状态。本研究分别利用Genecards数据库和蛋白质组学分析，鉴定了经先导化合物D1处理的SIRS小鼠肝脏（独特且重要的免疫器官）中的疾病靶点和差异蛋白。随后，通过上述差异表达蛋白与疾病靶点的交集分析，NOTCH1被确定为潜在的核心靶点。基于我们先前对构效关系的研究，设计并合成了一系列SIRS相关衍生物，其中将丁基、卤素和酯基引入二苯甲酮骨架，旨在从巨噬细胞极化的角度探索抗炎保护作用。值得注意的是，通过对接、SPR、DARTS和CETSA技术，这些衍生物表现出与NOTCH1的O-葡萄糖基化位点（SER496）或其邻近区域（如SER492、VAL485）的直接结合能力。机制上，衍生物D6通过双重NOTCH通路发挥抗炎作用。首先，它能抑制NOTCH1核转录活性，减弱NICD与RBPJK之间的相互作用，同时抑制NF-kappaB和NLRP3炎症小体（NLRP3、ASC和cleaved CASP1）的激活，并促进NICD（NOTCH1活性片段）的泛素化代谢（核转录通路）。其次，它可能具有增加PGC1alpha水平的能力，进而增强ATP和MMP水平，减轻ROS产生，增加线粒体数量，并改善线粒体炎症损伤（线粒体通路）。重要的是，激活剂Jagged1能有效逆转上述效应，而抑制剂DAPT则表现出协同作用，表明核转录调控和线粒体调控均以NOTCH1依赖的方式进行。随后，通过上调M2型巨噬细胞相关抗炎细胞因子（IL10、TGFbeta、CD206和ARG1）并下调M1型巨噬细胞相关促炎细胞因子（NO、IL6、IL18、iNOS、TNFalpha、CD86和IL1beta），有效缓解了炎症反应并保护了器官功能。总之，衍生物D6通过靶向抑制双重NOTCH通路，调节巨噬细胞极化并有效缓解SIRS。
